patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Office Timeline and Trello share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Office Timeline only if your buying job matches “PowerPoint-native timeline / Gantt specialist (now Lucen Timeline) — Free add-in; Lite fro” rather than Trello's shape. Choose Trello only if your buying job matches “Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual.” rather than Office Timeline's shape. Workflow advantage: Office Timeline leans timeline-reporting; Trello leans team-collaboration-work. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Office Timeline and Trello share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Office Timeline is PowerPoint-native timeline / Gantt specialist (now Lucen Timeline) — Free add-in; Lite from $9/user/mo annual.; Trello is Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Office Timeline (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Trello (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Office Timeline-leaning timeline-reporting vs Trello-leaning team-collaboration-work.
- Researched limits: Office Timeline — Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management; Trello — Limited planning depth vs Work OS.

Limitations — Office Timeline: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management; Centre of gravity is PowerPoint presentation timelines, not live team task execution; Trello: Limited planning depth vs Work OS; Premium needed for richer views.

Poor-fit cases: Office Timeline is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management · Trello is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Limited planning depth vs Work OS · Avoid Office Timeline if you actually need Trello's motion (Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual.)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
